about: Forced or idiom-only API-surface differences that `etc/api-surface.py check` must not report. Each rule names the element glob(s) (normalised keys, as `check` prints them), the aspect (type, kind, cases, member, params, optional, returns, ctor, ctor-optional, prop-optional, or *), the languages it covers, and the language feature that forces it. Optional `value` narrows the rule to a reported value glob; optional `kind` to a member that is a prop or a method in that language. Anything not listed here is a defect with a canonical decision in API_SURFACE.md.

allow.reason: AGENTS.md forced: rust has no exceptions (try_auth_headers is the Result variant) and trait objects have no RTTI (as_http_aware_mut is the downcast hook)
AGENTS.md forced: go reports caller mistakes as exported sentinel error values (errors.Is), not exceptions
go has no exceptions: the error-returning variant of authHeaders sits beside the infallible interface method, as rust's try_auth_headers does
go's error protocol: Error() string, Unwrap() error and As(any) bool are how errors.Is/As walk the chain; Cause/Msg are the fields behind them
go has no operator overloading or equals protocol; Equal is the go-cmp convention, the counterpart of equals/== that the extractor ignores elsewhere
dart has no reflection-based deserialiser; the fromJson factory is the dart:convert / json_serializable convention every dart model carries
swift's LocalizedError.errorDescription and CustomReflectable.customMirror protocol requirements
swift's Foundation convention names a wrapped error underlyingError (NSUnderlyingErrorKey); swift keeps it, dart does not (see API_SURFACE.md)
no implementation inheritance: rust reaches the parent error by a composition accessor, elixir by an is-a predicate (api_error?/1)
elixir structs are transparent maps: every field is readable, there is no private field to hide an authenticator's or client's state in
OTP and module conventions: start_link/1 starts the token-manager GenServer, __using__/1 is the behaviour macro, exceptions/0 lists the hierarchy for rescue clauses
AGENTS.md forced: dart operations take an explicit options/server argument with no default, a deliberate uniform dart signature
elixir has no receiver: the api struct is the first argument
AGENTS.md forced: php types a defaulted, schema-non-nullable property as non-nullable
AGENTS.md forced: php's \Exception declares protected int $code, so the OAuth2 error code is errorCode
.NET exception design (CA1032): every exception exposes the (message, innerException) chaining parameter, named innerException
php's \Throwable chains through the constructor argument named $previous
swift's Foundation convention names a wrapped error underlyingError
AGENTS.md forced: csharp releases resources through IDisposable.Dispose()
AGENTS.md forced: elixir has immutable data and no builder; new/1 takes a keyword list
AGENTS.md forced: go has no static methods; the builder is the package-level NewConfigurationBuilder()/NewTransportOptionsBuilder()
elixir new/1 takes a keyword list (AGENTS.md); node takes one options object, the TypeScript named-argument idiom
AGENTS.md forced: rust/swift expose the default configuration through Default/default(); elixir mirrors it as default/0
rust models oneOf/anyOf as a sum type (enum with payloads), its only tagged union
rust has no implementation inheritance; the shared behaviour is the Authenticator trait's default methods
no implementation inheritance (elixir behaviour, go embedding of an empty struct): the members live on each authenticator
a model named Result would shadow the prelude Result (rust std::result::Result, Swift.Result) that the generated code itself uses
a model named Error would shadow java.lang.Error / the Swift.Error protocol that every throwing signature uses
TypeScript has no nominal types: branded aliases (UUID, URI, Email, Decimal), inline literal unions and structural helper types are how node spells formats and enums the others give a class

rust/go support types: newtypes for the orphan rule and serde (JsonValue, DateTime, Base64Serde), the request-option struct their APIs take instead of overloads, and the error-kind enum rust matches on
go stdlib gaps and func types: no Set, no ISO-8601/protobuf duration or date-only type, a named func type for the trace hook
Codable has no Any (AnyCodable) and no recursive value types (Indirect); Foundation/dart have no ISO-8601 duration codec
dart has no stdlib UUID; NO_AUTH needs a concrete class to be a const sentinel (AGENTS.md: sentinel shape is forced)
php: PSR-4 puts the NO_AUTH sentinel in its own file (AGENTS.md), the PSR-18 adapter and symfony serializer normalizers must be public classes to be registered, and php has no duration type
ruby: the dry-types Types module and the Faraday params encoder are library integration points; the *Composite structs back dry-struct anyOf
elixir anyOf needs a struct to hold the matched variants
AGENTS.md forced: caller mistakes are a typed Err (rust) / ConfigurationError (swift), and the not-yet-exchanged code is OAuth2AuthorizationCodeError in both
module-level constants are the python/dart namespace for SERVER_0.. (a class of constants is not idiomatic); the extractor reads them as a module

composed-schema plumbing the language's serializer hooks require (pydantic RootModel, dry-struct, symfony normalizer, serde untagged enum); the caller-facing accessor is actualInstance/matchedInstances, decided in API_SURFACE.md
go and rust have no default arguments: the trailing optional clientAuthMethod is set by a With* option instead of a constructor parameter
go and rust have no default arguments: the constructor stops before clientAuthMethod, which WithClientAuthMethod sets
go and rust have no default arguments or overloads: the optional extraHeaders/refreshUrl arguments become the *WithHeaders/*WithRefresh variants
params is a C# keyword (variadic modifier); the argument is named parameters

the type witness is language-specific: Class<T> (java), a reified/generic type parameter with no value argument (kotlin, csharp, rust), a class-string (php), a decoder (dart), a target pointer (go), a metatype (swift), a module (elixir)
the platform exception base class already carries the cause (Throwable.getCause, Exception.InnerException, Throwable::getPrevious)
ES2022 Error takes the cause in an ErrorOptions object: new Error(message, { cause })
rust has no overloads or default arguments: the request-content-type variant is a separate *_with_content_type method
rust has no overloads or default arguments: the request content type is taken by the *_with_content_type variant
go and rust have no default arguments: noRedirect and friends travel in the RequestOptions of send_request_with_options
elixir folds trailing optional arguments into a keyword opts list
spec-derived: the server's description text ("CDN-backed read endpoint") names the type, not the generator
ruby's HttpAwareAuthenticator is a mixin module included beside the Authenticator superclass; a module cannot inherit the class's methods
dart, swift and go cannot detect an optional OpenTelemetry dependency at runtime (no optional import), so the application registers the propagator through this hook
rust ownership: into_data(self) moves the payload out; borrowing languages have no by-value counterpart
